calculation_notes.rsi: Wilder RSI(14), calculated on all returned sector closes
calculation_notes.historical_percentile: average-rank percentile in [0,100] within trailing 365 calendar days ending at observation date
calculation_notes.turnover: rolling mean of five sector kline exchange values
calculation_notes.share: rolling-five sector amount sum divided by rolling-five (sh000001.amount + sz399001.amount) sum
calculation_notes.attention: cross-sectional average-rank percentile of current sector five-day average amount
calculation_notes.missing_policy: retain returned zeros; do not impute missing market data; catalyst and fundamental remain null
